scope: Only each exact diagnostic process; unrelated application private bytes are excluded

memory_map.limitations: Sequential metadata queries, not atomic. Concurrently freed regions can fail queries; only the default heap is summarized, not all DLL-owned private heaps.

heap_traces.scope: default heap; existing IAT references only
heap_traces.limitations: IAT coverage only; no release through cached function pointers or subsequently loaded imports. Unobserved releases can overstate live bytes; failed frees can understate them. Optimized tail calls can omit frames; no private NVIDIA symbols. Instrumentation changes allocation timing and has fixed native table overhead.
